versions.changelog:
Expanded coverage to include additional core Twilio APIs and features.

- Added references and guidance for Twilio Studio, Lookup, Proxy, Sync, TaskRouter, and Segment/Engage APIs.
- Updated documentation to reflect broader API support beyond Messaging, WhatsApp, Voice, Conversations, Verify, and SendGrid.
- Skill description and quick orientation now list new supported surfaces and workflow references.

Initial release of Twilio API skill with advanced workflow guidance.

- Covers Messaging, WhatsApp, Voice, Conversations, Verify, and SendGrid APIs.
- Provides production-oriented guides for direct HTTPS workflows.
- Emphasizes webhook safety and operational guardrails.
- Includes quick orientation and references for each Twilio service.
- Lists required inputs and offers operational and security best practices.
